title: Optimize set operation ORDER BY limit sorting
constraints: Preserve UNION/INTERSECT/EXCEPT ORDER BY, LIMIT, and OFFSET semantics
rationale: The set operation path fully sorted outer ORDER BY results before applying LIMIT/OFFSET. When LIMIT is finite, retaining only OFFSET + LIMIT candidates before final ordering reduces sort work while preserving the returned window.
steps: Parse set operation outer LIMIT/OFFSET before sorting
Use select_nth_unstable_by to retain OFFSET + LIMIT candidates for finite windows
Preserve stable tie behavior with original row indices in the top-k selection path
Apply LIMIT/OFFSET after final ordering of the retained window
Add SQL integration coverage for UNION ALL ORDER BY with LIMIT and OFFSET
expected_impact: Reduces set operation outer ORDER BY sorting work for limited result windows.
